messages:
arjun: Carrier flagged shipment for manifest/serial mismatch. Vendor says replacements coming but ETA sliding to Thu EOD. We have 8 pending H100 jobs this week — need decision: accept vendor IOU loaners vs expedite air re-route (costly). Any preferences?

lina: Which PO/serials affected? how big is the risk to reserved pools?

arjun: PO 98763. Manifest snippet below:
```
AWB: FFX1234567
SKU: H100-80GB x20
Reported: missing serials -> S-1001,S-1002,S-1003,S-1004
```

ev an: If we expedite air it pushes ETA to Wed night but ~+$12k + customs broker surcharge. IOU loaners keep us online sooner but could be older firmware/variants. Tradeoffs: cost vs validation time. :airplane: :moneybag:   

lina: Any direct SLO impact for Dedicated customers?

arjun: Two Dedicated tenants use those reserved racks. Without replacements we'll have 6-12h degraded throughput unless we re-route. Ops says we can shift low-priority batch workloads to usa-east spare pool to keep 90% latency SLOs for critical routes. Need approval for surcharge if we go air.

vendor-ops-bot: RMA ticket created: #RMA-87321. Vendor-provided ETA for replacement shipment: 2026-03-25. Tracking: https://carrier.example/track/FFX1234567

ev an: Prefer IOU + validation window. Plan: accept loaners into eqx-dc2 hot pool, run firmware/thermal checks (1hr), then swap into serving pool. Ask vendor for pre-shipment photos + manifest scan.

lina: Ok. @finance please standby for a quick approval if expedite is needed. Also Lina needs cost delta for air vs IOU and an ops runbook for validation.

arjun: pinging vendor rep now — cc @maria (vendor). Opening change CHG-4521 to allow hot-swap into eqx-dc2. Will update here.

maria: We can cover up to $3k of customs/broker fees; rest would be on Redwood. We can also send pre-shipment photos and a scanned packing list within 2h.

lina: If vendor covers broker fees, expedite. Otherwise IOU plan approved by me pending firmware check.

ev an: Scheduling validation window for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Assigning to ops-team for checks.

arjun: Thanks. I'll post manifest scan / new AWB here when vendor confirms. TIA.
